headline: Northwest Nazarene's unbeaten start ends at home
dek: Northwest Nazarene lost at home to Colorado Mesa on Saturday, the last programme in the conference to take a defeat. They had won twice and drawn three times before it. Every side has now lost at least once, and only Seattle Pacific and Western Washington are yet to draw.
displaced_by: Northwest Nazarene lost at home to Colorado Mesa; no unbeaten side remains
